additional_info.subject: RE: 0414566 - ID0414566-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / P1 170000224] Outlet 3 out of order CRM:00796001457
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
This issue (SECC has a communication error with the PLC) sometimes occurs in the charger when the PLC checks the availability of the outlet. If the feedback times out, this error triggers the error flag. It is typically resolved within 5 seconds. This issue may be addressed in the upcoming firmware release.
If no further support required kindly let me close this ticket.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
